name: Message to the Wildhammer

chain: The Final Message to the Wildhammer

summary: At Revantusk Village, Otho Moji'ko wants a message carried to the Wildhammer dwarves. Their new allies include the high elves, and Otho wants his warning written in the blood of the Highvale high elves at Quel'Danil Lodge.

sections.title: A Message in Blood
sections.body:
The Wildhammer are making alliances with the trolls' enemies, and now the high elves stand with them. Otho Moji'ko spits at the thought. He wants the dwarves warned in the blood of their new friends. Slaughter every Highvale high elf you find and leave the bodies as a warning.

Highvale Outrunners, Scouts, Marksmen and Rangers gather at Quel'Danil Lodge, in the northwest of the Hinterlands.

sections.title: Word at Revantusk Village
sections.body: When you return to Revantusk Village, Otho declares that the Revantusk are making new alliances too. He praises your work.

aliases: who gives message to the wildhammer
faq.answer: Otho Moji'ko offers it from Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Where are the Highvale high elves located?
faq.answer: The Highvale high elves gather at Quel'Danil Lodge, in the northwest of the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Why does Otho Moji'ko want the high elves attacked?
faq.answer: Otho says the Wildhammer are striking deals with the trolls' enemies, and now they are working with the high elves. He wants a message carried to the Wildhammer dwarves, written in the blood of the high elves.

faq.q: Which Highvale elves does Otho want slaughtered?
faq.answer: Otho wants the Highvale Outrunners, Scouts, Marksmen and Rangers at Quel'Danil Lodge slaughtered.
